description: Agent runtime composition root for Agentic OS
pre_install: Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.598.0/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '1808593ee854ca8a20bc285f285881807293b767eeec2da7cbe7a98434f1ca30') { throw 'aoscompose checksum mismatch' }

Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.598.0/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '4add02570c43e9929cb2551a9bb1a01382e920552046d5d42e8a0222e513830b') { throw 'aosguard checksum mismatch' }
